plain.li: With the stores this low, {OTHER_nameDef} wants "{WISH}"?
Can we fix the leaks in the roof before anyone starts on "{WISH}"?
I'm not saying no, only that food and walls come first.
[poor] We can't pay for it, not while we're down to the last sacks of grain.
[winter] Every hand on "{WISH}" in the middle of winter is one less hand cutting firewood.
[afterraid] We were patching wounds half the night, and now "{WISH}" comes first?
[trait:Ascetic] We've managed without it this long, so what's changed?
[trait:Ascetic] I sleep on a bedroll and eat what I'm given, and I don't see why anyone needs more.
[trait:Jealous] {OTHER_nameDef} asks and the council listens, while my request last month went nowhere.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] That's days of work for one person's comfort, with fields to sow and walls to finish.

warm.li: Sorry, {OTHER_nameDef}, but some of us are still sleeping on the floor.
Could it wait until we all have a bed and a hot meal?
I'd say yes in a better season, {OTHER_nameDef}, but not this one.

blunt.li: No. Ask me again after the harvest is in.
{OTHER_nameDef} wants "{WISH}" and I want boots without holes, and we can both wait.
Give {OTHER_nameDef} "{WISH}" and the rest of us will be lining up tomorrow.

cheerful.li: I like it, I really do, but can we come back to it once the walls are up?

gloomy.li: As if we didn't have enough to look after, now there's "{WISH}".
We'll spend everything we have on it, and the raiders will carry it off in the end.

cold.li: I object. The materials for "{WISH}" are needed elsewhere.
{OTHER_nameDef}'s comfort is not a colony priority.
